R4.quiz_question: A colleague emails you an unexpected link asking for your login. What should you do?
quiz_options: Report it through the security channel and don’t click
Click it to check whether it’s real
R4.quiz_explanation: Suspicious requests are reported, not tested — that’s the core of the awareness training.
R4.module_purpose: Know the everyday security expectations — phishing, passwords, reporting — from your second day onward.
R4.objective: Recognise common security threats and report them correctly.
R4.task_description: Finish the security awareness course and its short knowledge check.
R4.task_expected_outcome: Course and knowledge check completed; completion is visible to your manager.
R4.checklist_activity: Security awareness training — done within 2 days of joining

R1.module_purpose: Get a working, approved development environment so every later engineering task happens safely in the sandbox rather than on production systems or personal machines, as the onboarding requirement expects of new engineers.
R1.objective: Configure the approved workstation image and a sandbox you can build and test in.
R1.task_description: Install the approved image, request sandbox access, and run the sample build end to end.
R1.task_expected_outcome: Sample build passes inside the sandbox.
R1.checklist_activity: Workstation + sandbox ready within 2 days of your joining date
R1.quiz_question: Where should you run code while onboarding?
R1.quiz_explanation: All onboarding work happens in the approved sandbox.

R5.module_purpose: Read the required policies and record that you have done so on your first day.
R5.task_description: Read each required policy and submit the acknowledgement form.
R5.checklist_activity: Policy acknowledgement within 1 day of joining
R5.quiz_question: How soon must policies be acknowledged?
R5.quiz_explanation: The requirement allows 1 day from the joining date.

R2.module_purpose: Write and review code using the required secure coding practices.
R2.objective: Apply secure coding practices in your own changes and in code review.
R2.task_description: Complete the secure coding course, then fix the seeded issues in the sandbox exercise repository.
R2.task_expected_outcome: Course done; all seeded issues fixed and reviewed.
R2.checklist_activity: Secure coding training finished within 5 days of joining
R2.quiz_question: Which modules must be finished before secure coding?
R2.quiz_explanation: Secure coding builds on the sandbox and on security awareness.

R6.module_purpose: Show you’re ready to work independently.
R6.objective: Demonstrate what you learned across onboarding.
R6.task_description: Take the final assessment once every other module is complete.
R6.checklist_activity: Final assessment within 7 days of joining
R6.quiz_question: When can you take the final assessment?
R6.quiz_explanation: It depends on every other onboarding requirement.

R3.module_purpose: Demonstrate the approved branch → review → merge workflow on a real change.
R3.objective: Use the approved repository workflow from branch to merge.
R3.task_description: Open a branch, make a small change, get it reviewed and merge it following the workflow.
R3.task_expected_outcome: A reviewed change merged through the approved workflow.
R3.checklist_activity: Repository workflow demonstrated within 6 days of joining
quiz_options: Demonstrating the workflow on a reviewed change
R3.quiz_explanation: It must be demonstrated, not just read.

plan_title: Your first week as an engineer
plan_summary: Policies and security first, then sandbox setup and secure coding, a hands-on repository exercise, and a final assessment on day 7.
